verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order but scatters the text column with arbitrary large gaps (headline, body, CTA and legal float far apart). The book is shrunk, jammed toward the right edge and detached from its circle, which sits orphaned in the bottom-right. B groups the headline, body and legal into one tight block and keeps the book large, partly over the circle as in the original. But it puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks the reading order and hierarchy, the book is off-centre on the circle, and the bottom third is dead space.
